description: Machine-readable remediation guidance for EPER/DX. Never capture API keys, SMTP passwords, cloud secrets, DKIM private material, message bodies, or recipient content in diagnostics.

entries.fix: Use a valid trimmed mailbox and remove control/header characters.
Correct the concrete message field named by the diagnostic.
Use a fully-qualified public DNS name with valid labels.
Correct transport credentials, sender identity, region/domain or provider settings.
Use a provider-local path beginning with one slash, not a full URL.
Use a method supported by the provider and RBE net:http.
Supply the correct provider credential through authorized configuration.
Correct the provider resource identifier named by the diagnostic.
Use the verified Mailgun sending domain only.
Use the domain registered and verified in SendPulse.
Use a valid AWS region containing the SES identity.
Use a valid still-supported legacy template identifier.
Use the documented SMTP address and port with secure TLS policy.
Use the provider SMTP credentials; they may differ from API credentials.
Pass a fully-qualified public domain.
Remove CR/LF/control characters from structured header values.
Use a supported simple template variable name.
Supply valid mail DNS names, public IP and secure ownership token.
Generate 32 CSPRNG bytes and pass their 64-character hex encoding.
Use the publicly routable IPv4 address that receives SMTP.
Use valid RFC-style Message-IDs and References values.
Use HTTPS for one-click unsubscribe; use only supported URI schemes otherwise.
Keep OTP fields bounded and expiry within the documented range.
Approve the requested capability and reactivate the package host session.
Inspect self_hosted_capabilities() and approve every missing prerequisite.
Approve net:tcp for mail; never bypass RBE with ambient/raw sockets.
Approve net:tcp and net:tls; never downgrade SMTP to plaintext.
Approve net:dns and reactivate the package session.
Run through activated RBE/RPX package hosting and inspect ABI/session diagnostics.
Approve crypto or supply a separately generated 256-bit token.
Verify or rotate credentials and sender/domain permissions.
Honor provider backoff and reduce concurrency.

entries.whatFailed: Provider quota or billing limit reached
entries.fix: Fix billing/quota/account state before retrying.
Correct the rejected field or provider policy condition.
Retry with exponential backoff or deliberately switch configured provider.
Treat delivery as ambiguous and inspect provider/idempotency state before resend.
Inspect the lower-level RBE broker diagnostic and retry only safe operations.

entries.whatFailed: RBE request or response limit exceeded
entries.fix: Reduce or split data to fit broker limits.
Correct the recipient or remote recipient policy.
Approve net:tls/net:tcp and require STARTTLS; never continue plaintext when absent/failing.
Approve net:tcp-listen before starting inbound SMTP.
Approve service:package and verify the package contains service/**/*.service.
Inspect recipient DNS and lower-level RBE DNS diagnostics.

entries.whatFailed: No mail exchanger or address fallback
entries.fix: Correct the recipient domain; it has no usable MX or address fallback.
Do not retry; the domain explicitly accepts no email.
Retry only the affected domain with exponential backoff.
Inspect SMTP stage/status and correct sender, recipient, content or policy before retrying.
Some domains already accepted the message; retry only undelivered recipients/domains.
Use ASCII envelope mailbox addresses until SMTPUTF8 negotiation is implemented.
Install or restore the named prerequisite and rerun the build helper.

entries.whatFailed: Latest green RBE commit could not be resolved
entries.fix: Check GitHub access/token or use a known-green full RBE SHA.

entries.whatFailed: RBE source checkout or backend build failed
entries.fix: Fix the first Git/RBE compiler diagnostic; refresh the cached checkout if corrupt.

entries.whatFailed: RBE SDK bootstrap or status failed
entries.fix: Inspect backend install/sdk status and repair the project-local SDK.

entries.whatFailed: RPX validation or package compilation failed
entries.fix: Fix the first RPX/compiler diagnostic printed above this wrapper error.
Preserve sanitized response detail plus RBE/package versions and report compatibility drift.
Stop before SMTP and preserve the DNS/RBE diagnostic; never guess MX state.

entries.whatFailed: Malformed SMTP or TLS broker response
entries.fix: Stop the SMTP transaction and preserve sanitized protocol/RBE details; never infer success.
Report the code, package version, RBE commit and minimal reproducer.
Correct host time synchronization before sending or provider signing.
